pretreatments.description: Chemo-mechanical pretreatment using NaOH (pH 10) combined with disperser (IKA T25 Ultra Turrax) at 12,000 rpm for 30 min, applied at specific energy of 4544 kJ/kg TS, to enhance sludge disintegration, solubilization, and biodegradability before anaerobic digestion.

Chemo-mechanical pretreatment using KOH (pH 10) combined with disperser (IKA T25 Ultra Turrax) at 12,000 rpm for 30 min, applied at specific energy of 4544 kJ/kg TS, to enhance sludge disintegration, solubilization, and biodegradability before anaerobic digestion.

Chemo-mechanical pretreatment using Ca(OH)_2 (pH 10) combined with disperser (IKA T25 Ultra Turrax) at 12,000 rpm for 30 min, applied at specific energy of 4544 kJ/kg TS, to enhance sludge disintegration, solubilization, and biodegradability before anaerobic digestion.
